column1: # FT-710 DISPLAY library functions (T23d): armcc C library (ARM Compiler 5 / RVCT) and NORTi uITRON 4.0 service calls.
# Reviewed table, written by hand from the evidence column (instruction idioms in arm-none-eabi-objdump listings, the
# uITRON 4.0 API: object tables, id ranges, error codes E_ID/E_NOEXS/E_OBJ/E_QOVR/E_TMOUT/...). Method and score per row.
